name: github-account-identity
description: Browser extension that displays the current GitHub account identity on issue/PR pages

scripts.release: npm run build && node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');const v=require('./package.json').version;execSync('zip -r github-account-guard-v'+v+'.zip manifest.json popup.html dist/ icons/',{stdio:'inherit'});console.log('Created github-account-guard-v'+v+'.zip');"
